items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03
items.q: Oh, sometimes in Texas, I'd run across Blind Lemon.

ctx.x: Well, what about. Did you hear any blues pickers up there? No. I don't know. Indianapolis. I mean, real. No. You know, finger picking style. No, no. Yeah.
No, most of that was almost obsolete. Mm-hmm. Oh, sometimes in Texas, I'd run across Blind Lemon.
